conversations.legacyBody: Taking a quiet evening after that post. Thanks for checking in — what helps you unwind?

text.en: Taking a quiet evening today. What helps you unwind?
text.fr: Je prends une soirée tranquille aujourd’hui. Qu’est-ce qui t’aide à décompresser ?

conversations.legacyBody: A walk and a few pages helped me slow down. Do you have a favourite quiet spot?

text.en: A coffee break and some music helped me slow down. What are you listening to lately?
text.fr: Une pause café et un peu de musique m’ont aidé à ralentir. Qu’est-ce que tu écoutes en ce moment ?

requestText.demo-request-in: Busy days can still feel lonely. Would you like to say hello?
requestText.demo-request-out: I connected with your post about being understood. Happy to start with a hello.

greeting.en: Hey! How has your day been?
greeting.fr: Salut ! Comment s’est passée ta journée ?
